text: New Era Cap is controlled by its founding family, the Koch family of Buffalo; private equity firm ACON Investments holds a significant stake. ACON's roughly $700 million continuation fund, closed in August 2022, made Major League Baseball, the National Football League and the National Basketball Association minority owners in New Era Cap.
short: New Era is controlled by its founding Koch family; MLB, the NFL and the NBA took minority stakes in 2022.
